description: proposal.create's agent_import refusal for a relative path (S37 T4, AD2): the payload decode refuses a relative path BEFORE the seam is ever called — a relative path resolves against whoever's working directory is running at the time, and create and commit are not guaranteed to be the same process — so no row is written. The reason is this slice's own words (never the plugin layer's), and the shape is identical to every other kind's refusal (one Aeon code, three parts).

data.means: nothing was written — a refused proposal leaves no row, never one carrying an error flag
